messages:
liz: quick heads-up — PR #472 (console/observability) has a few mismatches: cost/latency breakdowns show different field names, the python tracehook example is missing, and one playground embed returns 404. can we triage?
aj: on it. can you point to the exact files?
sam_k: which embed URL? i can run a quick link-checker.
liz: files are under docs/console/costs.md and docs/observability/tracing.md. embed is the playground iframe in docs/console/playground.md — link looks like /playground/examples/trace-preview which 404s in prod.
maria: i can take the python snippet. do we want a minimal tracehook example + the db cost attribution snippet in the same PR?
liz: yes — one PR to keep migrations atomic. minimal python tracehook snippet should mirror the js example but show `TraceContext` attach + cost metadata. short and copy-pastable.
maria: draft here: ```python
from redwood import TraceHook, attach_context

hook = TraceHook(service="console-playback")
attach_context(hook, {"trace_id": "{{trace_id}}"})
# add cost tags
hook.set_tag("cost.tokens", 42)
```
sam_k: looks good. i'll run link-check on the playground URL and open an infra ticket if the route is missing. quick check: the cost doc uses `token_cost_usd` while tracing uses `cost_tokens_usd` — that's the mismatch.
aj: glad you caught that — we should standardize to `token_cost_usd`. i'll update the tracing examples and send a small linter to catch both variants.
docs-bot: PR 472 opened by liz — reviewers: @maria @aj. CI: docs-link-check pending.
devops: if the playground route is missing i can sync with infra. ping me if you want the redirect.
liz: thanks. plan: maria will add python snippet + fix playground iframe URL, aj will normalize field names and add linter rule, sam_k will confirm link or file needed from infra. aim to merge by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
aj: adding a tiny eslint-style rule for docs linter to catch `cost_tokens_usd` vs `token_cost_usd`. will add test.
maria: pushing a WIP commit in ~30m. i'll keep examples minimal and include a one-line note about why we standardize the field name.
sam_k: link-checker run started — will report back in this thread.
docs-bot: docs-link-check — playground URL returned 404 (200 expected). created issue infra#289 to investigate.
liz: perfect — thanks everyone. i'll mark the PR as WIP until we have the infra fix or the redirect./end of thread
